info.name: Mobile CTF Platform API
info.description:
# Mobile CTF Platform API Collection

Comprehensive Postman Collection for the Mobile CTF Platform backend service.
Includes endpoints for Authentication, Challenges, Submissions, Leaderboards, Terminal Containers, Events, Teams, Announcements, Offline Notes Sync, Bookmarks, and Admin Operations.

## Quick Start
1. Ensure the backend is running locally at `http://localhost:4000`.
2. Send **Authentication > Login (Player)** to automatically store `accessToken` and `refreshToken` into collection variables.
3. Send **Authentication > Login (Admin)** to automatically store `adminAccessToken` into collection variables.
4. Execute any authenticated endpoint — tokens are injected automatically.

## Rate Limits
- Login: 5 requests / min / IP
- Submissions: 5 attempts / min / user / challenge
- General API: 100 requests / min / user (or IP)

variable.description: Admin access token (auto-populated on admin login)
Admin refresh token (auto-populated on admin login)

item.name: 1. System & Health
item.description: Liveness, readiness, and metrics monitoring endpoints.

request.description: Returns service status, application version, process uptime, and current UTC timestamp.
Checks connectivity to PostgreSQL database, Redis instance, and Docker Sandbox container daemon. Returns HTTP 200 when ready or 503 when any dependency is down.
Returns runtime metrics in Prometheus text format (process uptime, memory RSS).

item.name: 2. Authentication
item.description: User registration, login, JWT token rotation, session management, and password resets.

request.description: Registers a new user account with role USER and returns access and refresh JWT tokens.
Authenticates player credentials. Rate limited to 5 attempts/minute/IP. Automatically sets `accessToken` and `refreshToken` in collection variables.
Authenticates default seeded Admin user. Sets `adminAccessToken` in collection variables.
Rotates the refresh token and issues a new access token and refresh token.
Returns profile details of the authenticated user (id, username, email, role, lastLoginAt).
Revokes the specified refresh token session.
Invalidates all active sessions and refresh tokens for the current user.
Requests a password reset token. In non-production environments, returns `devResetLink` directly in response.
Resets the user password using a valid reset token.

item.name: 3. Challenges & Submissions
item.description: Browsing challenges, fetching details, unlocking hints, and submitting flags.

query.description: Category slug (crypto, web, forensics, reversing, osint, misc)
Scope challenge list to specific event

request.description: Paginated challenge list. When authenticated, indicates which challenges have been solved or bookmarked.
Lists all available challenge categories with icons, sort orders, and challenge counts.
Lists all challenge tags with usage counts.

query.description: Optional event context to check unlock rules

request.description: Fetches detailed markdown description, hints (with bodies masked until unlocked), attachments, and solve status. Raw flags or hashes are never exposed.

query.description: Event ID if submitting inside a competition event

request.description: Submits a flag attempt. Rate limited to 5 attempts/minute/challenge. Computes hint penalties, 10% first-blood bonus, global/event leaderboard scores, and rank update.
Unlocks a hint for the user. Deducts hint penalty points from the eventual solve score and returns the revealed hint body.

item.name: 4. Leaderboard
item.description: Global, daily, and weekly competitive ranking tables.

request.description: Returns top scorers and personal rank. Redis ZSET powered.
Returns leaderboard for points scored today (UTC).
Returns leaderboard for points scored this week (Monday UTC).
Returns the current user's global rank, total score, and solve count.

item.name: 5. Terminal & Sandbox
item.description: Isolated ephemeral container sessions for command-line security challenges.

request.description: Spawns an isolated, non-root Alpine container (ctf-sandbox). Bounded concurrency, no host access, auto-expiring in 30 minutes. Limits: max 2 active sessions per user.
Returns all terminal sessions belonging to the current user with statuses and expiry times.
Fetches status and metadata for a specific terminal session ID (format: `tm_<hash>`).
Gracefully closes and destroys the container sandbox session.

item.name: 6. Events & Competitions
item.description: Scheduled CTF events, countdowns, unlock rules, and event-scoped rankings.

query.description: Filter events: all, upcoming, running, ended

request.description: Lists CTF events with start/end windows, registration status, and participant counts.
Returns event overview, registration status, countdown, and active team affiliation.
Registers the authenticated user (and their active team, if applicable) in the event.
Unregisters the user/team from the specified event.
Returns event-specific leaderboard for individual participants or teams.
Lists all challenges in the event along with dynamic unlock rules (TIME, PREREQUISITE, SCORE, ALWAYS) and lock status.

item.name: 7. Teams
item.description: Team formation, join codes, invitations, and member role management.

request.description: Searches and lists public teams, member counts, and team leaders.
Returns the current user's team membership, join code, and member list.
Returns team details, description, and public roster.
Creates a new team. The creator automatically becomes the LEADER. Generates a unique 6-character join code.
Joins an existing team using its 6-character join code.
Leader-only: invites a registered user to the team, generating an 8-character invite code.
Accepts an invite using the received invite code.
Promotes or demotes a team member (LEADER or MEMBER).
Removes a member from the team, or allows a member to leave. Auto-promotes the oldest member if the leader departs.
Leader-only: deletes and disbands the team.
Returns announcements, prioritized by pinned status then creation date.

item.name: 9. Notes & Offline Sync
item.description: Offline-first personal challenge notes with conflict-free Last-Write-Wins (LWW) synchronization.

request.description: Returns all non-deleted notes for the authenticated user ordered by update time.
Batch synchronizes client notes. Compares client and server timestamps using Last-Write-Wins and returns the authoritative state of all user notes.
Creates or updates a single note by its clientKey.
Soft-deletes a note so it is excluded from active lists while propagating tombstone across syncing devices.

item.name: 10. Bookmarks
item.description: Personal pinned challenges for quick mobile reference.

request.description: Returns all challenges bookmarked by the user with solve status.
Bookmarks a challenge. Automatically evaluates and triggers the CURATOR achievement.
Removes a challenge from bookmarks.

item.name: 11. Achievements
item.description: Gamification badges, streaks, and milestone tracking.

request.description: Returns all platform achievement definitions (FIRST_BLOOD, SPEED_DEMON, CURATOR, POLYGLOT, STREAK_3, etc.) and timestamps when earned by the user.

item.name: 12. Admin Operations
item.description: Authoring and management endpoints for Challenges, Hints, Events, and Announcements. Requires MODERATOR or ADMIN role.

item.name: Challenges
item.description: Create, update, version, and delete challenges.

item.name: Hints
item.description: Create, modify, and delete challenge hints with point penalties.

request.description: Adds a hint with penalty points to a challenge.
Modifies hint details or penalty value.
Deletes a hint.

item.name: Admin - Add Challenge to Event (with Unlock Rule)

request.description: Maps a challenge to the event with an optional unlock rule (ALWAYS, TIME, PREREQUISITE, SCORE).
Updates sort order or unlock condition for an event challenge.
Removes a challenge from the event.
Publishes a new announcement.
Updates announcement content or pinned flag.
Deletes an announcement.
